_: Teaser « Doji contre le Bruit » (ouverture du 11/01/2027), casting de la grosse voix FR (06/11/2026). Voix originales créées par Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign : personne n'est imité.

lines.text: Il crie plus fort que les faits.
Mais cette fois… quelqu'un lui répond.
Chaque annonce, vue avant qu'elle tombe.

lines.tts: Quatre cent soixante-deux idées testées. Six ont survécu.

lines.text: Et avant chaque trade… le feu vert.
MACROARSENAL. Le 11 janvier, le bruit s'arrête.
lines.tts: Macro Arsenal. Le onze janvier, le bruit s'arrête.

voices.label: FR, grave et chaleureux (film d'animation)
voices.design: A deep, warm French male narrator in his fifties, the kind of rich velvety bass voice heard in trailers for big family animated movies: deep and resonant but friendly, with a hint of a smile and a sense of wonder. Perfect native Parisian French diction. Real human voice recorded close to a professional studio microphone, natural breathing and tiny imperfections, relaxed, never robotic, never synthetic.

voices.label: FR, très grave et épique
voices.design: A very deep, booming French male trailer narrator in his forties, huge chest resonance and slow gravitas, the voice of epic blockbuster teasers, with a slight natural grain. Perfect native French diction. Real human voice recorded close to a professional studio microphone, natural breathing, lived-in and organic, never robotic, never synthetic.

voices.label: FR, grave, malicieux et moderne
voices.design: A deep, modern French male voice-over artist in his thirties with a low, smooth and slightly playful tone, confident and cool, like the narrator of a bold tech product launch with humour. Perfect native Parisian French diction. Real human voice recorded close to a professional studio microphone, natural breathing, relaxed and conversational, never robotic, never synthetic.

acting: Read it like the voice-over of a punchy animated movie teaser: deep, calm and confident, short sentences that land on the beat, real pauses between sentences. Slightly mysterious at the start, a knowing smile on « quelqu'un lui répond », energy rising through the list, and a big, warm, unforgettable final line. Never shouting, never rushed, never theatrical; sounds like a real actor in a real studio.
